CustomField.description: Sum of soft-credit giving from legacy or external systems (archived CRM, spreadsheet migration, prior fundraising platform). Populated once during import and preserved thereafter — NPC rollups do not touch this field. FQS donor-grouping formulas add this to the standard TotalSoftCreditsAmount rollup when the tier's Credit_Type__c CMDT setting is "Hard + Soft Credits". Leave blank for donors with no pre-system soft-credit history.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total soft-credit giving from a legacy or external system. Adds to the standard TotalSoftCreditsAmount rollup when the donor grouping tier is configured to count soft credits.
CustomField.label: Legacy Soft Credit Total
